source_quote: Low-activity dogs had significantly higher obesity prevalence.
Sedentary small companion dogs maintained high periodontal prevalence.
Medium energy profiles showed stable otitis prevalence.
Atopic dermatitis prevalence remained moderate in medium-energy dogs.
High-energy dogs showed elevated cruciate rupture burden.
High-energy lineages had increased EIC prevalence in field activity.
Extreme activity dogs demonstrated highest cruciate incidence among energy strata.
Extreme-energy dogs had increased heat-stress events under warm conditions.
High-drive dogs showed elevated exertion-associated GI disturbances.
High-energy dogs developed moderate osteoarthritis prevalence with age.
